title: Entering the Kingswood from its south track a second time (after backtracking) produced a room named 'the South Track' (lowercase 'the'), distinct in the log from the earlier-visited 'The South Track' (capitalized) at the same border crossing — reads as a duplicate/typo rather than an intentionally distinct location.
where: Kingswood / South Track (entry from the Iron Downs)
